categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in property and casualty insurance, including motor vehicle insurance, commercial property insurance, cargo insurance, liability insurance, accidental injury insurance, short-term health insurance, agriculture insurance, credit insurance, surety insurance, household property insurance, marine hull insurance, and related reinsurance businesses. It also engages in investment and funds application businesses permitted under PRC laws.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced actuarial, underwriting, and claims settlement capabilities, risk-based pricing models, and digital transformation technologies including AI platforms to enhance operational efficiency and customer service. It has developed proprietary catastrophe models and insurance products tailored to technology, green finance, and digital finance sectors, and utilizes risk reduction services supported by digital risk surveys, IoT early warnings, and weather forecasting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad customer base including individual customers (128 million) and corporate customers (4.444 million) across various sectors such as motor vehicle owners, agriculture, health, liability, commercial property, and emerging industries. It also supports micro, small and medium-sized enterprises, private enterprises, rural households, and new citizens, with significant involvement in national strategies and social security systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly concentrated in Mainland China, with significant insurance coverage in 143 countries and regions overseas supporting Chinese enterprises' international interests. Key provinces with high premium income include Guangdong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shandong, Hebei, Sichuan, Hubei, Hunan, Anhui, and Fujian.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily downstream in the insurance value chain, providing insurance products and services directly to customers and managing claims and risk reduction services. It also engages in reinsurance activities and investment management, positioning itself as a comprehensive insurer and financial service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include serving national strategies through technology finance, green finance, inclusive finance, elderly care finance, and digital finance. The company focuses on innovation in insurance products for technology breakthroughs, green initiatives, inclusive coverage, and digital transformation using AI and big data. It aims to enhance risk reduction services, improve underwriting and claims efficiency, and build a world-leading property and casualty insurance company.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through insurance premium income from various insurance products, reinsurance contracts, and investment income from financial assets. The company also earns fees from insurance agency services, brokerage commissions, and service fees related to customer service and asset management agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the largest property and casualty insurer in Mainland China with a market share of 31.8%, maintaining a leading position in the industry. It competes with other domestic and international insurers but leverages its scale, comprehensive product offerings, and strategic alignment with national policies to sustain its market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported original insurance premium income of RMB538.055 billion in 2024, a 4.3% increase year-on-year, with net profit reaching RMB32.161 billion, a 30.9% increase. Total assets stood at RMB778.244 billion, with a return on equity of 13.0%. The company has demonstrated steady growth in revenue, profitability, and capital strength, supported by a comprehensive solvency margin ratio of 232.6%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, people-centric insurance services aligned with national development goals, offering innovative and tailored insurance products for technology, green, inclusive, elderly care, and digital finance sectors. It differentiates itself through comprehensive risk reduction services, extensive coverage including rural and emerging markets, strong claims settlement capabilities, and digital transformation to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
